name: Stone Giant

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.description: The giant has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two Greatclub attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

description: Stone giants are reclusive artisans who dwell in cavern halls beneath the mountains, hurling boulders with uncanny accuracy at any who disturb their solitude.
